---

## 1. Company Background & Manufacturing Infrastructure
Gagan Engineering Works was founded in 2006 in the industrial corridor of Khopoli, Maharashtra (between Mumbai and Pune). The workshop specializes in heavy-duty metal forming machinery, roll forming production lines, hydraulic coil processing equipment, and thermal pressing machinery for intimate apparel.

All fabrication, CNC turning, roller machining (EN31 alloy tool steel), hydraulic power pack assembly, and electrical control panel wiring are executed in-house.

---

## 2. Complete Machinery Catalogue & Technical Specifications

### Category A: Bra Cup Moulding Machines (Intimate Apparel & Lingerie Sector)

#### 1. Double Head Electric Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `double-head-electric-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **Application**: Continuous simultaneous moulding of seamless bra cups, swimsuit padding, and activewear inserts.
- **Drive System**: Dual independent pneumatic press cylinders with electric heating platens.
- **Heating Control**: Dual Microprocessor Digital PID Temperature Controllers (0°C to 250°C).
- **Production Output**: 400 to 600 pieces per 8-hour shift.
- **Platens**: High-grade hardened alloy tool steel with uniform surface thermal distribution.
- **Power Supply**: 3-Phase 415V AC, 50Hz.
- **Clamping**: Automated pneumatic cylinder with digital dwell timer.
- **Compatible Materials**: Polyurethane (PU) foam sheets, laminated fabric-foam composites, polyester fiberfill, spandex.

#### 2. Bra Cup Fabric Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `bra-cup-fabric-moulding-machine`
- **Application**: Wrinkle-free moulding of woven, knitted, and laminated fabrics.
- **Moulds**: Precision CNC-machined aerospace-grade aluminium dies (interchangeable for cup sizes 28A through 44DD).
- **Cycle Time**: 25 to 40 seconds per pressing cycle.
- **Temperature Range**: 0°C to 220°C with independent top and bottom thermal zones.
- **Air Pressure Required**: 5 to 7 bar (kg/cm²).

#### 3. Foam Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `foam-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **Application**: High-density polyurethane foam cup formation with zero thermal discoloration.
- **Heating Mechanism**: Heavy-duty cast platen elements with zero thermal gradient.
- **Thickness Range**: 2 mm to 25 mm foam thickness capability.

#### 4. Padded Bra Cup Moulding Machine
- **Model ID**: `padded-bra-cup-moulding-machine`
- **Application**: Multi-layered composite padding forming foam, fabric, and inner lining in a single cycle.
- **Pressure Control**: Proportional pneumatic pressure regulation for delicate microfibers.

---

### Category B: Roll Forming & Sheet Metal Machinery (PEB & Industrial Roofing)

#### 5. 10 Tons Hydraulic Decoiler
- **Model ID**: `10-tons-hydraulic-decoiler`
- **Coil Weight Capacity**: Up to 10,000 kg (10 Metric Tons).
- **Mandrel Expansion**: Hydraulic wedge-type expansion mechanism (480 mm to 520 mm standard coil ID).
- **Coil Width**: 300 mm to 1250 mm.
- **Drive**: 5.5 kW / 7.5 HP geared electric motor with AC Variable Frequency Drive (VFD).
- **Braking**: Heavy-duty pneumatic disc brake with proximity loop control arm.

#### 6. Automatic Roofing Sheet Crimping Machine
- **Model ID**: `automatic-roofing-sheet-crimping-machine`
- **Application**: Hydraulic curved profile step-crimping for pre-painted galvanized iron (PPGI), Galvalume (PPGL), and aluminium corrugated sheets.
- **Profile Radius**: Adjustable radius for industrial shed eaves, ridges, and arched canopies.
- **Control**: Touchscreen PLC with programmable step pitch and angle.

#### 7. C & Z Purlin Roll Forming Machine
- **Model ID**: `c-z-purlin-roll-forming-machine`
- **Application**: Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) structural roof and wall purlins.
- **Section Sizes**: Web 80 mm to 300 mm, Flange 40 mm to 80 mm, Lip 10 mm to 20 mm.
- **Sheet Thickness**: 1.5 mm to 3.2 mm high-tensile CR / HR / Galvanized steel.
- **Speed**: 10 to 18 meters per minute with flying hydraulic cut-off.

#### 8. Corrugated Sheets Making Machine
- **Model ID**: `corrugated-sheets-making-machine`
- **Roll Stations**: 14 to 18 roll forming stations with hardened chrome-plated EN31 rollers.
- **Cutting**: Hydraulic stop-to-cut guillotine blade.

---

### Category C: Coil Processing Lines

#### 9. Automatic Cut To Length (CTL) Line
- **Model ID**: `automatic-ctl-machine`
- **Max Sheet Thickness**: Up to 6.0 mm (Mild Steel) / 4.0 mm (Stainless Steel).
- **Max Coil Width**: 400 mm standard (customizable up to 1500 mm).
- **Line Speed**: 15 to 25 meters per minute.
- **Leveler Unit**: 9 to 13 precision rolls with hardened alloy steel (52–54 HRC) gear driven.
- **Shearing Unit**: High-speed mechanical/hydraulic cut-to-length shear.
- **Automation**: Siemens / Delta PLC with touchscreen HMI for multi-batch length programming.
